title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #1044: Boundary Length of Polynomial Level Sets. Status: SOLVED (Tang)

title: Hasrootsindisk
content: A monic polynomial with all roots in the closed unit disk |zᵢ| ≤ 1. We represent it by its list of roots. ∀ z ∈ roots, Complex.abs z ≤ 1

title: Maxboundarylength
content: The maximum boundary length Λ(f) of the sublevel set {z : |f(z)| < 1}. This is the maximum over all connected components of the perimeter of that component.

title: Tang Infimum Eq Two
content: **Tang's Theorem**: The infimum of Λ(f) over all polynomials with roots in the unit disk is exactly 2.  More precisely: for every ε > 0 there exists a polynomial f with roots in the unit disk such that Λ(f) < 2 + ε, but Λ(f) > 2 for all such f. (∀ roots : List ℂ, HasRootsInDisk roots → roots ≠ [] →

title: Infimum Approached
content: ∃ roots : List ℂ, HasRootsInDisk roots ∧ roots ≠ [] ∧ maxBoundaryLength roots < 2 + ε := tang_infimum_eq_two.2 ε hε

title: Rootsofunity
content: The nth roots of unity: {e^(2πik/n) : k = 0, ..., n-1}. These are the roots of z^n - 1. (List.range n).map (fun k => Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * k / n * Complex.I))

title: Tang Conjecture
content: **Tang's Conjecture**: For each fixed degree n, the polynomial z^n - 1 minimizes Λ(f) among all degree-n polynomials with roots in the unit disk.  Verified for n = 1 and n = 2. ∀ roots : List ℂ, roots.length = n → HasRootsInDisk roots → maxBoundaryLength (rootsOfUnity n) ≤ maxBoundaryLength roots

title: Degree One Boundary
content: For the degree 1 polynomial f(z) = z - z₀ with |z₀| ≤ 1, the sublevel set {z : |z - z₀| < 1} is a disk of radius 1, whose boundary has length 2π. maxBoundaryLength [z₀] = 2 * Real.pi

title: Erdos 1044
